# Quill by CopyByMonk

> Quill turns one set of property notes into a complete, compliant listing pack for UK estate agents (residential sales). Speak or type the facts once and generate a Rightmove-ready portal description, 6–10 Key Features bullets, a short teaser summary, an Email Blast for your applicant database (Quill doesn't send emails) and social captions for Instagram, Facebook and X.

## Pricing

- Starter £39/month — 15 listings per month.
- Pro £79/month — 50 listings per month.
- Growth £149/month — 120 listings per month.
- The Starter plan begins with a 14-day free trial (card required at checkout, cancel anytime).
